elevator_pitch: A high-efficiency synchronous buck converter built around the TPS2832 gate driver and dual CSD18534KCS N-channel MOSFETs, with a TLV2372-based inverting feedback amplifier for output regulation.
description:
• Synchronous topology with dual MOSFETs delivers 5 A continuous at >90% efficiency — roughly 10% above an equivalent diode-based design.

• TLV2372 error amplifier closes the voltage-feedback loop against a 1.25 V reference for stable regulation across multiple loads.

• Thermal relief vias under both MOSFETs connect to a bottom copper pour; 4.7 µH inductor and 220 µF ceramic capacitor minimize switching ripple.
